name: Nico Minoru

abilityDetails.Adrenaline: Zamanla azalan beyaz bir can barı olarak depolanır. Saldırılarla verilen hasar, depolanan Adrenaline'i cana çevirir; bu dönüşüm İyileşme Engeli gibi etkilerden etkilenmez.
abilityDetails.Flourish: Muharebe Güç Oranını ve Yetenek Güç Oranını belirtilen güçte artırır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Pentacle: Doğal dünyanın uyumunu temsil eder ancak oyun içi bir etkisi yoktur.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Buff Immunity: Etkilenen şampiyonlar buff'lara bağışıklık kazanır; mevcut buff'lar kaldırılır ve yenileri kazanılamaz.
abilityDetails.Pre-Fight: Dövüş başlamadan önce Pre-Fight ekranından değiştirilebilen yetenek.
abilityDetails.Stimulate: Combat Adrenaline'i sabit bir miktar artırır.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Halt: Unstoppable şampiyonlar, vuruşlara sanki Unstoppable değillermiş gibi tepki verir.
abilityDetails.Poison: Zamanla zehir hasarı verir ve iyileşme etkilerini %30 azaltır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Dövüşe 11sn'lik bonus immünitesiyle başlar (bonus tetiklenirse zehir/asit yakma uygular — kozmik olmayan zehir-immün şampiyon en iyisi). E1'i mutlaka kaçır (son vuruşu bloktan bile doğrudan enerji hasarı verir); E2'ye zorlamak daha güvenli (bonus immünitesini yeniler ama kaçması kolay). E1 sonrası 4sn görünmez olur.
signatureAbility:
W.I.T.C.H.
Whenever a Buff or personal effect on the Opponent other than Poison is prevented or removed by Immunity, Nico inflicts a [1,887.37 - 4,791] Poison Passive for 12 seconds. Max stacks: 20.
Personal effects on the Opponent are paused during Nico's Special Attacks.
When Nico causes an attack to Miss, she Passively gains [448.17 - 3,038.72] Adrenaline. Cooldown: 0.5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Blood Mage - Always Active
content: As a Defender, Nico stores 40% of all damage taken as Adrenaline, and while she has more than 5% Adrenaline stored, she gains an indefinite 15% Flourish Passive.
Each time Nico gains a total of 5% of her Max Adrenaline, gain a +[1,916.4] Fury Passive for 15 seconds. Max stacks: 7.
When Nico activates any Special Attack, she Passively Converts up to [6,077.44] Adrenaline to Health per level of the Special Attack.
Nico starts each fight with 100% of the Adrenaline she finished her previous fight in the same Quest with. Personal Furies gained at this time gain 200% increased duration.

abilitySections.title: Hex Girl - Buff Hunter
content: Nico's Heavy charge and third Light Attack place an indefinite Pentacle Buff on the Opponent.
When the Opponent gains a Buff, Nico Passively gains 2% of her Max Power. When one or more Buffs are prevented or removed by Immunity, she gains 3%.
Nico does not benefit from the Mystic Dispersion Mastery. Instead, each rank increases the base potency of personal Power Gains by 10%.
Passively gain 1% of missing Health as Adrenaline when a Buff on the Opponent is prevented or removed by Immunity. Cooldown: 1 second.
Nico can inflict a Buff Immunity Debuff for 11 seconds, refreshed when Nico casts any Special Attack. As a Defender, this is a Passive instead.

abilitySections.title: Staff of One -
content: Nico is magically bound to the Staff of One, a powerful artifact that can cast potent spells. Each lasts until the Opponent is defeated and cannot be cast again within the same quest.
As a Defender, Nico always casts Unworthy.

abilitySections.title: Spells of the One - Once Per Quest
content: Unworthy - Nico inflicts her personal Buff Immunity at the start of the fight.
Absorb - Nico gains a 55% Stimulate Passive while Blocking.
Ward - Nico gains Immunity to Poison and Rupture effects.
Burn - Nico's Poison effects are replaced by Incinerates, but deal 30% reduced damage.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: As an Attacker, the first hit consumes 7% of Nico's current Health and stores it as Adrenaline.
On the final hit, or when canceling this attack with a Special 1 or 2, gain a Zeal Passive for 6 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, inflict a Halt Passive for 13 seconds, refreshed when Nico casts any Special Attack. Does not apply if active.

The final hit deals a burst of [14,373] Energy Damage, increased by 20% for each Damaging effect on the Opponent, up to 10. This can trigger through Block. As a Defender, the total potency is reduced by 50%.
After the final hit, Nico gains an Invisibility Passive for 4 seconds. If this causes an attack to Miss, it goes on cooldown for 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Each hit inflicts a [28,746] Poison Debuff for 30 seconds, paused during the Opponent's Special Attacks.
If a Cosmic Opponent is Immune to any of Nico's Poisons, she inflicts a matching Acid Burn instead.
The final hit inflicts Nico's Buff Immunity. As a Defender, this applies on activation. Does not apply if active.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: This attack gains +[3,832.8] Attack for each Damaging effect on the Opponent.
The first time this attack is used each fight, Nico increases the duration of personal effects by 50% for the rest of the fight.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - W.I.T.C.H.
content: Whenever a Buff or personal effect on the Opponent other than Poison is prevented or removed by Immunity, Nico inflicts a [1,887.37 - 4,791] Poison Passive for 12 seconds. Max stacks: 20.
Personal effects on the Opponent are paused during Nico's Special Attacks.
When Nico causes an attack to Miss, she Passively gains [448.17 - 3,038.72] Adrenaline. Cooldown: 0.5 seconds.
